user.title: Connect a MakerWorld collection
user.description: This integration only reads collection and model metadata. Public collections work without a token. Tokens are stored in the Home Assistant config entry and are never exposed as entity attributes or logs.

data_description.collection_slug: The final URL segment, for example 35678497-home-prints.
data_description.printer_device_id: Select the cloud-connected P2S that should receive print jobs.
data_description.access_token: Leave empty for a public collection. Never enter your password.

reauth_confirm.title: Update MakerWorld access
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement token, or leave empty to use public access.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the MakerWorld collection. Check the ID/path and try again.
error.invalid_auth: MakerWorld rejected the access token. Replace it or leave it empty for a public collection.

abort.already_configured: This MakerWorld collection is already configured.
